SELECT r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.weeks_in_period, r.first_fiscal_week, r.last_fiscal_week, r.fully_loaded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date) AS stock_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_groups
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3

WITH x AS (
 SELECT w.week_ending_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, w.closing_units, w.closing_value, p.standard_unit_cost, w.etl_loaded_at, w.store_key, w.product_key
 FROM fact_stock_week w
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
 WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_id, sku)) AS n_nat, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_900plus, SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category='Paint & Decorating' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pd_rows,
  MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT w.week_ending_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category AS cat_asof, cp.category AS cat_current, w.closing_units, w.closing_value, p.standard_unit_cost, cp.standard_unit_cost AS cur_cost
 FROM fact_stock_week w
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900 AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT week_ending_date,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' THEN closing_value END) AS pd_value,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_asof='Paint & Decorating' THEN closing_value END) AS pd_value_aswas,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' THEN closing_units END) AS pd_units,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' THEN closing_units*standard_unit_cost END) AS pd_units_x_cost,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' AND closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' AND closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_val,
 SUM(CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' AND abs(closing_value-closing_units*standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cat_current='Paint & Decorating' THEN store_id END) AS stores
FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT w.week_ending_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, p.delisted_on, w.closing_units, w.closing_value
 FROM fact_stock_week w
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
 WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-07-12' AND s.store_id<900
)
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, a.category, a.delisted_on, a.closing_units, a.closing_value
FROM x a WHERE a.week_ending_date='2026-07-05'
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM x b WHERE b.week_ending_date='2026-07-12' AND b.store_id=a.store_id AND b.sku=a.sku)
ORDER BY a.category, a.sku, a.store_id LIMIT 70

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT w.week_ending_date, SUM(w.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week w
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = w.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.week_ending_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_closing_stock_value_at_cost_eur, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly
